label: Direct SDK / hand-written retrieval loop
route_note: The application owns both the trajectory and the set of actions the trajectory can reach. Absorbing a re-keyed corpus requires adding the list_chunks route and a branch that consumes it, after the evaluation split has already been run.
widening_note: Widening cost is direct_sdk/widened.py plus the routes_for branch in workflow.py.
fixture_mode_note: Deterministic driver stands in for the model; these numbers measure route flexibility and retrieval reach, not answer quality.
